81	@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
82	class RouteRefInfo:
83	    """Decomposed route reference metadata."""
84	
85	    raw: str
86	    prefix: str
87	    number: str
88	    route_type: RouteType
89	    canonical_name: str
90	    is_valid: bool
91	    qualifier: str | None = None
92	
93	    @property
94	    def street_type(self) -> str:
95	        """Route type label (e.g. 'Quốc Lộ', 'Đường Tỉnh')."""
96	        if not self.is_valid:
97	            return ""
98	        name = self.canonical_name
99	        if self.qualifier and name.endswith(f" {self.qualifier}"):
100	            name = name[: -(len(self.qualifier) + 1)]
101	        if self.number and name.endswith(f" {self.number}"):
102	            name = name[: -(len(self.number) + 1)]
103	        return name or self.canonical_name
104	
105	
106	def _normalize_number(number: str) -> str:
107	    """Uppercase optional alphabetic suffixes while preserving digits and hyphens."""
108	    if not number:
109	        return number
110	    norm = _DASH_NORMALIZATION_RE.sub("-", number.strip())
111	    return norm.upper()
112	
113	
114	def _build_canonical_name(form: str, number: str, qualifier: str | None = None) -> str:
115	    label = _CANONICAL_LABELS[form]
116	    base = f"{label} {_normalize_number(number)}"
117	    if qualifier:
118	        return f"{base} {qualifier}"
119	    return base
120	
121	
122	def _split_compact_prefix(text: str) -> str:
123	    """Insert a space between compact route prefixes and following digits (e.g. QL1A -> QL 1A)."""
124	    split_dot = _COMPACT_PREFIX_RE.sub(r"\1 ", text)
125	    return _COMPACT_PREFIX_NO_DOT_RE.sub(r"\1 ", split_dot)
126	
127	
128	def _invalid_info(raw: str) -> RouteRefInfo:
129	    return RouteRefInfo(
130	        raw=raw,
131	        prefix="",
132	        number="",
133	        route_type="unknown",
134	        canonical_name="",
135	        is_valid=False,
136	        qualifier=None,
137	    )

140	def _is_bare_ct_prefix_match(match: re.Match[str], rule: _PrefixRule) -> bool:
141	    if rule.canonical_form != "cao_toc":
142	        return False
143	    return normalize_ascii(match.group("prefix")) == "ct"
144	
145	
146	def _is_standalone_route_ref(working_ascii: str, match: re.Match[str]) -> bool:
147	    before = working_ascii[: match.start()].strip()
148	    after = working_ascii[match.end() :].strip()
149	    before = _STANDALONE_ROUTE_PREFIX_STRIP_RE.sub("", before).strip()
150	    return not before and not after
151	
152	
153	def _is_ct_tower_block_number(number: str) -> bool:
154	    """CT1 / CT12A-style residential tower blocks, not zero-padded expressway codes."""
155	    norm = number.upper().strip()
156	    if not norm or norm.startswith("0"):
157	        return False
158	    m = _CT_TOWER_BLOCK_NUMBER_RE.fullmatch(norm)
159	    if not m:
160	        return False
161	    digits = int(m.group(1))
162	    letter = m.group(2)
163	    if letter is not None and digits <= 13:
164	        return True
165	    return digits <= 9 and letter is None
166	
167	
168	def _accept_bare_ct_expressway(working_ascii: str, match: re.Match[str], number_raw: str) -> bool:
169	    if _BUILDING_RESIDENTIAL_CTX_RE.search(working_ascii):
170	        return False
171	    if _EXPRESSWAY_INDICATOR_RE.search(working_ascii):
172	        return True
173	    if _is_standalone_route_ref(working_ascii, match):
174	        return not _is_ct_tower_block_number(number_raw)
175	    return False
176	
177	
178	def _resolve_suffix_qualifier(m_qual: re.Match[str]) -> str | None:
179	    raw = (m_qual.group("paren_q") or m_qual.group("bare_q") or "").strip().lower()
180	    raw = collapse_whitespace(raw)
181	    if not raw:
182	        return None
183	    if canon := _ROUTE_QUALIFIER_CANONICAL_MAP.get(raw):
184	        return canon
185	    if raw.startswith("nhanh "):
186	        parts = raw.split(maxsplit=1)
187	        return f"nhánh {parts[1].upper()}" if len(parts) > 1 else "nhánh"
188	    return None
189	
190	
191	def _extract_route_qualifier(working_ascii: str, match: re.Match[str]) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
192	    """Extract and validate route qualifier from pre-match or trailing tail.
193	
194	    Returns (is_valid, canonical_qualifier).
195	    """
196	    tail = working_ascii[match.end() :].strip()
197	    pre_q = match.groupdict().get("pre_qualifier")
198	
199	    qualifier: str | None = None
200	    if tail:
201	        if not (m_qual := _ROUTE_SUFFIX_QUALIFIER_RE.match(tail)) or not (
202	            qualifier := _resolve_suffix_qualifier(m_qual)
203	        ):
204	            return False, None
205	    elif pre_q:
206	        pre_norm = collapse_whitespace(pre_q.strip().lower())
207	        qualifier = _ROUTE_QUALIFIER_CANONICAL_MAP.get(pre_norm, "tuyến tránh")
208	
209	    return True, qualifier
210	
211	
212	@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=8192)
213	def parse_route_ref(text: str) -> RouteRefInfo:
214	    """Parse a Vietnamese route reference into structured metadata."""
215	    if not isinstance(text, str):
216	        return _invalid_info(str(text) if text is not None else "")
217	
218	    raw = text.strip()
219	    if not raw or _DIGIT_MATCH_RE.search(raw) is None:
220	        return _invalid_info(raw)
221	
222	    normalized = collapse_whitespace(normalize_unicode_nfkc(raw))
223	    ascii_norm = normalize_ascii(normalized)
224	
225	    if ascii_norm in _FALSE_POSITIVE_BLOCKLIST:
226	        return _invalid_info(raw)
227	
228	    working = collapse_whitespace(_KM_PREFIX_RE.sub("", normalized).strip())
229	    if not working:
230	        return _invalid_info(raw)
231	
232	    working_ascii = collapse_whitespace(_split_compact_prefix(normalize_ascii(working)))
233	
234	    for rule in _PREFIX_RULES:
235	        match = rule.pattern.search(working_ascii)
236	        if not match:
237	            continue
238	
239	        number_raw = match.group("number")
240	        if _is_bare_ct_prefix_match(match, rule) and not _accept_bare_ct_expressway(
241	            working_ascii, match, number_raw
242	        ):
243	            continue
244	
245	        is_tail_valid, qualifier = _extract_route_qualifier(working_ascii, match)
246	        if not is_tail_valid:
247	            continue
248	
249	        number = _normalize_number(number_raw)
250	        canonical_name = _build_canonical_name(rule.canonical_form, number, qualifier)
251	
252	        return RouteRefInfo(
253	            raw=raw,
254	            prefix=rule.prefix_code,
255	            number=number,
256	            route_type=rule.route_type,
257	            canonical_name=canonical_name,
258	            is_valid=True,
259	            qualifier=qualifier,
260	        )
261	
262	    return _invalid_info(raw)
263	
264	
265	def is_route_ref(text: str) -> bool:
266	    """Return True when *text* is a recognized route reference."""
267	    return parse_route_ref(text).is_valid
268	
269	
270	def is_highway_km_post(text: str | Any) -> bool:
271	    """Return True when *text* contains a bare kilometer-post marker (km\\d+).
272	
273	    A km-post marker indicates that house numbers along the segment follow
274	    highway chainage rather than a monotonic street sequence, so linear
275	    corridor monotonicity checks must be suppressed.
276	
277	    Unlike :func:`is_route_ref`, this function does NOT require a route-type
278	    prefix (QL, CT, etc.) — it detects the raw ``km\\s*\\d+`` pattern.
279	
280	    Parameters
281	    ----------
282	    text : str
283	        Raw street name or address fragment to examine.
284	
285	    Returns
286	    -------
287	    bool
288	        True if a km-post marker is detected anywhere in *text*.
289	    """
290	    if not isinstance(text, str):
291	        return False
292	    return bool(_KM_POST_MARKER_RE.search(text))
293	
294	
295	def canonicalize_route_ref(text: str | Any) -> str:
296	    """Return canonical route name, or the original text when not a route ref."""
297	    if not isinstance(text, str):
298	        return ""
299	    info = parse_route_ref(text)
300	    if info.is_valid:
301	        return info.canonical_name
302	    return text.strip()
